title: WHY does this 216-foot tower cast NO shadow at noon? #Shorts
description:
WHY does this 216-foot tower cast NO shadow at noon?

Popular viral myth says the temple never casts any shadow. Scientific reality: the stepped pyramidal geometry of the 16-tier Vimana is calculated so that at equinox noon, the shadow folds precisely within the stepped stone plinth, creating the illusion of shadowlessness.

Produced by ARIA Sacred Heritage AI. Subscribe for the full 52-minute documentary.
